description: This file defines a UI component named 'Details' that displays recipe details, including ingredients and steps, with loading and error handling. It imports external UI components, theme data, and a data service to fetch recipe data by ID.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: A Lightning.js component that renders the details view for a recipe, including image, ingredients, and steps, with loading and error states.

methods.name: bullet
methods.description: Formats an ingredient string with a bullet point.

methods.name: stepNum
methods.description: Formats a step index and description into a numbered step string.

methods.name: onMounted
methods.description: Lifecycle method that fetches recipe data by ID when the component is mounted.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Method to navigate back to the previous route.
